## Feature Description
A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
Explain what problem this feature would solve or what need it addresses.

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you thought of any alternative solutions or features?

## Additional Context
Any other context, mockups, or examples that would help explain the feature.
